answer: The vine I would price into every new account is Acclaimed nuclear technician licence with atomic energy authority attestation: a licence the authority renews after reactor audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a licence the authority renews after reactor audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the inlet is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The copper is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
